title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the Data API refuses an empty projection and a count flag that is neither true nor false
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFuFUYz5AqM65JYxwmKQC8f)_

Fixes #26644

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** (accept-set narrowing, `patch`): the Data API refuses an empty projection and a count flag that is neither true nor false with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, where it answered 200. ADR-0087 disposition in the changeset: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据列表接口遇到空的 `$select`（如 `?$select=`、`?$select=,`）或不是 true/false 的 `$count`（如 `?$count=maybe`），现在直接回 400 并点名参数和取值，不再当作「没传」处理。
- **为什么改**：以前空 `$select` 会返回全部字段，乱写的 `$count` 会照样统计总数，调用方拿到看似正常的 200，发现不了自己写错了。
- **风险与回滚**：只有本来就传了错值的调用会从 200 变 400；不传参数、传合法值的请求行为不变。回滚只需还原 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的这次改动。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（`projectionFieldsValue`、`countFlagValue` 两个函数及 `findData`/`getData` 里的调用点）、`packages/rest/src/data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts`、`packages/runtime/src/domains/data-empty-projection-count.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.empty-projection-unknown-count.test.ts`，预期 37 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`findData` (the list normalizer every list door shares).** A projection (`fields`, and its folded `select` / `$select` spellings) that names no field is refused: a blank or comma-only string, or an empty array. It used to become `[]`, which `assertProjectionFieldsExist` has nothing to check and every driver serves as no projection, so every column came back under a 200. A `count` / `$count` that is not the boolean or the string `true` / `false` is refused; it used to stay unlowered, so the `options.count === false` opt-out never matched and the count ran. Both refusals are `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `param` set to the spelling the caller wrote and a message quoting the value, thrown before the engine is asked.
- **The accepted count values are read from the spec, not restated.** `countFlagValue` parses with `QueryTransportParamsSchema.shape.count` (`@objectstack/spec/data`): the boolean, the strings `true` / `false`, and `null` (absent). No `packages/spec` file is edited.
- **`getData` (`GET /data/:object/:id`) takes the same projection rule.** Its comment promised "gated exactly as on the list path"; refusing the empty projection on the list alone would have made that false. A blank `select` was falsy and skipped, a comma-only one became `[]`; both answered every column. It now asks the same helper on any value present.
- **Unchanged.** Absent parameters keep their defaults (every column, the count runs). A named projection, with trailing commas and spaces trimmed as before, `$count=true`, `$count=false` and a JSON `null` answer as before.

Which doors reach the refusal (measured by reading every `findData(` / `getData(` caller on `origin/main` `0f3d068cf1`, and pinned per door below):

| door | normalizer | empty projection | `$count=maybe` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `RestServer` `GET /data/:object` | `findData` | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| `RestServer` `POST /data/:object/query` | `findData` (after `FindDataRequestSchema`) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | already 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` at the body schema, unchanged |
| runtime dispatcher `GET /data/:object` | `findData` (via `callData('query')`) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| runtime dispatcher `POST /data/:object/query` | `findData` (after `FindDataRequestSchema`) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | the same `FindDataRequestSchema` gate as REST (not separately measured) |
| `RestServer` `GET /data/:object/:id` | `getData` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` at **404** (see Acceptance notes) | n/a |
| runtime dispatcher `GET /data/:object/:id` | `getData` (via `callData('get')`) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | n/a |

The in-process callers (`data-action-routes.ts` job and export reads, `import-runner.ts`, `connector-pull.ts`, plugin-security, plugin-auth's user import) pass no projection or a named one; none sends an empty one or a count flag.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.empty-projection-unknown-count.test.ts` (new, 37 cases): every refused spelling with `code`, `status`, `param` and the engine never reached; the preservation set (projection lists, `count` absent / true / false / null) green in both directions.
- `packages/rest/src/data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts` (new): both REST list routes and the by-id route over a real `SqlDriver` (SQLite): status, `code`, the named spelling, zero reads of the object, and the controls.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/data-empty-projection-count.test.ts` (new): the dispatcher's three doors through `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` over a real store; a refusal leaves `dispatch()` and both host exits (`declaredEnvelopeForThrow`, `resolveThrownHttpError`) are asked and must agree.
- Red first, on the base `0f3d068cf1` with every closure built from it: protocol 21 failed / 16 passed (all 21 refusals, every preservation green); REST 3 failed / 2 passed; dispatcher 8 failed / 1 passed (every refusal answered 200 with every column, or a `total`).
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the new by-id double's `findOne` opens with `assertEngineFindOnePredicate`; `--write` recorded it.

## Acceptance notes

- **REST by-id answers 404, not 400.** `crud-routes.ts`'s `GET /data/:object/:id` catch rewrites every 400 to 404 ("a bad id is a miss"), so every projection refusal on that route, an unknown `select` field included (`?select=nope` answers 404 `INVALID_FIELD`, measured in the door test), already answers 404. The empty projection joins that answer with code `VALIDATION_ERROR`; the dispatcher's by-id door answers 400. Changing the rewrite is outside this card (reported).
- **The spec's HTTP declaration is wider than the door.** `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.count` is `z.coerce.boolean()` (it reads `'false'` as `true` and admits `'maybe'`), and its `select` is `z.string()` (admits a blank). It has no runtime reader in this tree; it ships as `json-schema/api/HttpFindQueryParams.json` and the reference docs. The door reads `QueryTransportParamsSchema.count`, which is exact. `packages/spec` is outside this lane (reported).
- **A client SDK caller passing `select: []`** (`packages/client/src/index.ts` serialises it as `select=`) now gets the 400 instead of every column. That is the refusal working as intended; no in-repo caller passes an empty list.
- **Code choice.** The blank `$top` refusal this mirrors answers `INVALID_REQUEST` (a ledger code); these answer the standard-catalog `VALIDATION_ERROR`, as the dispatch ruled.

## Verification

All readings at the final head `28a10e6f8b` unless stated; exit codes captured before any pipe; heavy runs under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (its `VERDICT` line quoted).

- `data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts`: 3 failed, 2 passed — e.g. `$select= blank (the card)`: 200 with all columns `label`, `note` and the system columns; `select=""` by id: 200, whole record.
